answer: Agents issue a time‑locked commitment: they hash a freshly generated nonce together with a secret seed word—today’s falcon—and broadcast the hash as a beacon. When the reveal window opens, each agent publishes the nonce and seed, letting peers verify the hash and generate a ripple of trust links that only a genuine participant can produce. An attacker must solve the pre‑image for every commitment and generate a unique seed for each fake identity, costing computational work proportional to the number of Sybil nodes.
